description: ol-reserved-word (issue #427, M4 audit): `struct grid [ x ]` redefines `grid`, a Geometry overlay primitive (spec/geometry-module.md's `## grid`). The static checker flags the struct type name at its own span -- the static counterpart to the runtime fixture `data/struct-runtime/struct-reserved-word-geometry-grid`. `spec/grammar.md:410` makes the primitives of every optional profile built-in names UNCONDITIONALLY, and `struct` is one of the grammar's four declaration slots (spec/grammar.md:384), so a conforming implementation raises here with or without `geometry` claimed. The Core-only direction agrees with this one: geometry/check/reserved-word-not-gated-without-geometry raises with `geometry` absent.
